CONVERSATION + CANVASIllustrative workspace
ONE PLACE TO WORK WITH AI

Talk about the work while you look at it. Ask for another version, change a supported control yourself, and continue from there.

Try an interactive example

01 / WORK THROUGH IT TOGETHER

Start with a goal.
Find the next step.

Bring a question, some rough notes, or a task you need to finish. Use text or configured voice to develop the work and redirect it as you learn.

Voice is an optional capability. Its availability depends on your setup and connected services.

02 / SEE IT AND SHAPE IT

A result you can
get your hands on.

Review documents, diagrams, and supported interactive tools beside the conversation. Make a change directly, or ask the agent to make it through shared controls.

Available viewers, controls, and editing options depend on the artifact and installed capabilities.

03 / KEEP BUILDING ON YOUR WORK

Something to
come back to.

Return to saved conversations and artifacts. Revisit supported versions and build on a result rather than having to explain the whole task again.

Accepted work can continue after a call ends while the Unified host remains running and available.

04 / MAKE ROOM FOR YOUR WAY OF WORKING

Let the tools
fit the task.

Add capabilities for the work you do. Choose supported AI connections, use installed skills and Smart Tools, and tailor supported parts of the workspace.

Connected accounts, providers, and tools need their own access and configuration.

CURIOUS ABOUT WHAT MAKES IT POSSIBLE?

A capable foundation.
A human starting point.

Amplifier supplies the underlying system for agents and tools. Unified brings those capabilities into a workspace you can direct.
